ValidationRule.description: Fields: TCV, Est. Start Date - required at Stage of Propose or later for Product or Professional Services record types Case00016020 - removed requirement for Amount to allow negative and zero dollar opps.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'True_Up', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Salesforce_Consulting' ), OR ( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Propose"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Contract"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Approve"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") ), ISBLANK( Est_Start_Date__c ) , ISBLANK( Project__c ) ) && NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) && NOT( $User.Id = '0053b00000CSZR6')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following fields are required to move this Opportunity to the next stage: Estimated Start Date, TCV. (If this is meant to be a zero dollar opportunity then please select Change Order for the Type field.)
